notes.title: v0.0.12
notes.content:
[h1]New[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added more hazards to levels.
[*]Added respawn points, which change where the player can respawn.
[*]Added new hat.
[*]Added option to hide usernames.
[*]Added shop to buy hats using coins. Existing hats now need to be bought through this.
[/list]

notes.title: v0.0.11
notes.content:
[h1]New[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added more to Sandbox Alternative level.
[*] Added UI to show collectables count. Coins show overall and Gems are level specific.
[*] Added save game to keep track of overall collectable count.
[*] Added transitions to help smooth level changes.
[*] Added hazards, which will kill the player and trigger a respawn to the start of the map.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed double versions in top right when playing.
[*] Main menu now properly deletes after joining/hosting.
[/list]

notes.title: v0.0.10
notes.content:
Patch Notes:

[*]Reworked player spawning with level loading to help prevent unsuccessful loads
[*]New level added (still needs building)
[/list]
